domain: Political Economy / Labor Systems / Epistemic Infrastructure
topic_summary: Analysis of a labor system where bodily transformation marks workers for disposal, but disposal itself becomes the mechanism of signal transmission. The narrative realizes a constraint topology where elimination creates the very connectivity it was designed to prevent, and where the boundary between extraction and contribution collapses through the worker's body.

key_entities: The Warden (enforcement apparatus executing disposal protocol)
The Archivist (observer tracking signal transmission across 713 instances)
The Archive (sealed knowledge system attempting connection through transformed bodies)
The Warren (labor collective performing kinship rituals)
key_tensions: Disposal protocol vs signal transmission (elimination creates connectivity)
Bodily integrity vs productive transformation (lattice growth marks both capacity and obsolescence)
Ritual exclusion vs material inclusion (nest-touch excludes her; stone receives her)
key_mechanisms: Flux monitoring threshold triggers disposal when crystalline intrusion reaches 12.3%
Falling body deposits hybrid tissue in rift walls, creating conductive pathways
Archive carrier wave reflects off deep boundary, returns altered through deposited nodes
absences: No mechanism for workers to contest disposal threshold or negotiate transformation timeline
No acknowledgment by enforcement system that disposal creates transmission rather than preventing it

omegas.description: Does the archive have agency or is it purely structural? Narrative treats it as 'having no cognition' but 'having direction.' If direction without cognition, is disposal_as_infrastructure_construction a Tangled Rope or an emergent Mountain?
Is 12.3% flux threshold a Mountain (physical safety limit) or a Snare (arbitrary control point)? Narrative does not provide evidence for physical necessity of this specific value.

Does the warren's ritual exclusion serve the disposal system or resist it? Exclusion prepares workers for reception by stone, but narrative does not clarify whether this is warren strategy or system capture of kinship practice.
